title: p07-design-audit-remediation (accepted)
decision:
Scoped amendment of D95 p.2–6 and D96 B, taking priority where they differ. Other decisions and D97 execution routing remain in force. Original review and decisions are preserved.

1. **A1:** delete WorkspaceContextBootstrapper in P07.1. Workspace state belongs to the manager. Closed stock order: Connection, CachePrefix, SessionConnection; host bootstrappers follow these and cannot depend on manager/context resolver. Eager singleton construction is acyclic; test with the actual container.
2. **A2–A3:** runFor includes initialize and setWorkspace inside try/finally. Track every started bootstrapper before calling it; revert the throwing bootstrapper and all predecessors, in reverse order. On find/resolve/bootstrap/event failure clear account/workspace and scoped cache. Common resetScope is used on every transition and failed initialization. Cleanup failure attempts all remaining revert operations and poisons runtime: subsequent access fails, resident application must be recreated before reuse. Failure to restore is propagated; it must not claim central safety.
3. **A4:** queues have per-instance LIFO frames keyed by the job object. Sync jobs and nested jobs restore the outer account/workspace after completion, including processing failure; async top-level starts and finishes central, missing account never runs in the old tenant. Sole completion event is JobAttempted from Worker/SyncQueue finally; other completion/error events cannot double-end/pop a frame. queue:retry keeps payload. Validation includes nested sync success/error and repeated completion.
4. **A5:** tenant cache allows redis/memcached/database prefixes and file path plus lock_path isolation, using SHA-256 account id. Copy and restore full store config, purge drivers. Unsupported stores fail options validation, including array; Testbench config explicitly uses isolated file fixtures. Prefix must contain %tenant%. hostCacheStore is explicit and outside tenant stores; database cache connection/lock_connection remain explicitly central. Key and lock isolation are acceptance, not inferred from config mutation.
5. **A6:** scope mutant deletes the single forgetScopedInstances call from common resetScope, so neither end nor initialize can compensate. Expected red: B receives held A writer. Additional transition-specific central→A and A→central tests do not perform a compensating switch.
6. **A7:** P07.1 disables actual fork discovery, root `extra.laravel.dont-discover=["axiomasoft/stancl-tenancy"]`; remove explicit Stancl provider from Testbench harnesses, assert package manifest absence. Do not rely on an ignored setting in dependency manifests. Before P07.2, retain only model/provisioning projections (models.tenant, database.central_connection/managers.pgsql/template_tenant_connection=null and UniqueIdentifierGenerator). identification.resolvers/middleware and bootstrappers are empty: no vendor runtime hooks/listeners. Own HostResolverCacheInvalidator starts P07.1 for both models; transitional observers listen also to stancl TenantSaved/TenantDeleted because Account maps saved/deleted events. P07.2 switches to plain Eloquent events and deletes the temporary projections/binding. Existing provisioning and UUID generation must pass without vendor provider in P07.1.
7. **A8:** P07.1 removes both tenancy() sites and the Stancl Account type in DatabaseImpersonationService using injected TenantContextResolver; AuthenticationRegistrar factory and runtime-globals baseline G2 19→17 belong to its Files. Grant ports/profiles remain P07.3; full baseline then becomes {}. Intermediate grep checks runtime imports/helpers; permitted model/provisioning imports remain until P07.2.
8. **A9:** inject public Matrix Contracts EntityActivity into DefaultAccessChecker and DefaultScopeResolver. Guard allowed, scopeFor, canOnRecord and query apply before memo/matrix/direct grants. Unknown and inactive entities deny with stale matrix and direct-grant rows. Scope predicates stay unchanged.
9. **A10:** delete azguard_role_id from Role model, RoleView and RoleMatrixData plus DatabaseRoleMatrixData and all callers/tests, not just migration. Bridge owns RoleLinkStore and aut_azguard_role_links; moved AutMatrixGrantSource joins it. Moved MatrixPermissionCatalogBuilder uses public EntityActivity; bridge never imports foreign Internal. Native compile dispatches RoleMatrixCompiled synchronously inside the transaction; bridge shares connection/transaction, failures roll back both; version invalidation runs afterCommit. RoleView constructor and removed bindAzGuardRole are explicit Golden/BC/changelog deltas under D01/D64.
10. **Verification:** examples are normative and executed from Markdown where possible; pure standalone PHP uses installed container/cache/queue events without database connections. PG and package runtime acceptance remains for future execution. Whole-plan finish refreshes carriers and fingerprint; no independent GREEN is inferred from corrective self-check.
rationale: A1–A6 are executable runtime isolation failures in the normative examples; A7–A8 make the intermediate item unbootable or its acceptance unreachable. A9 bypasses the adopted fail-closed rule, and A10 leaves deleted-column reads and forbidden package dependencies. The correction makes each boundary and its negative acceptance explicit before product implementation.
